title: NAACP president Derrick Johnson will appear on ESPN to discuss Protect College Sports Act

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NAACP president Derrick Johnson will appear on ESPN to discuss Protect College Sports Act
sources.description: After ESPN gave Senator Ted Cruz (R-Texas) a platform to push for the Protect College Sports Act, with no opposing view offered, the NAACP challenged ESPN to provide its president, Derrick Johnson, with a similar opportunity this weekend, when College GameDay goes to Oxford, Mississippi.
